tax_litigation.status: The company had received order from Assessing Officer for the assessment year 2014-15 for demand of income tax amounting to Rs. 1,701.16 lakhs (March 31, 2023, Rs 1,701.16 lakhs) towards disallowance of ESOP expenditures and other disallowances. The company has filed appeal against the above order with commissioner of income tax (Appeals) and has paid Rs.335.41 Lakhs (March 31, 2023: 200.00 lakhs) under protest. The CIT(A), vide order dated September 15, 2025, allowed partial relief by accepting the deductibility of ESOP expenses pertaining to non-promoter employees and partially allowing scientific expenditure claims. The hearing of the case is held on May 06, 2026. The liability has been disclosed as contingent liability.

tax_litigation.status: The company had received an order from Assessing Officer for the assessment year 18-19 for demand of income tax mounting to Rs. 7.08 lakhs towards disallowance u/s 14A of the Act. The company has paid the said demand within due date specified by the department. Further assessing officer had passed an order u/s 270A imposing a penalty for Rs. 3.47 lakhs (March 31, 2023, Rs 3.47 lakhs) lakhs for under reporting of income for incremental disallowance made u/s 14A of the act. The company had filed appeal against the penalty order with Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) and has paid Rs 0.70 lakhs under protest. The appeal proceedings against penalty are in progress. The liability has been disclosed as contingent liability.
